threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Dalston Junction' instead of just 'Junction.' Locals know to drop that fancy title once you're here a while.
Caught a night bus from Brixton, and a bloke started singing ‘Wonderwall’ like it was a karaoke bar. Best impromptu gig I’ve seen in ages.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw someone walking their pet ferret on a leash near the canal – felt like a scene from a local movie.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kebab shop that serves late-night currywurst, both wrapped in a pita. Pair it with a berliner Weisse and you’ve hit the jackpot.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from the Mission if they carry a permanent stash of hot sauce in their bag—gotta be ready for any burrito emergency.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy doing yoga in the back of a packed 38 Geary. Only in SF would that feel totally normal, even after the usual delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all live off tapas and sangria. Meanwhile, we're just trying to get our café amb llet fix in peace before work.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones staring wide-eyed at the menu, fumbling with their phones while trying to translate every word, oblivious to the waiters’ amused glances.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused at the bus timetable — it's like a puzzle that never gets solved, right?
Last night on the 36, a guy serenaded the whole bus with his acoustic set. Oddly somber, but the driver gave him a thumbs-up.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I realized I was home? Seeing the old lady at Kottbusser Tor, knitting while dodging the morning rush, utterly unbothered.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a spontaneous street wedding complete with a marching band, right outside a kebab shop. Happens more often than you think!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows the best taco truck is the one with the longest line, not the freshest paint job. The flavors speak for themselves.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 near Market; a guy was explaining his conspiracy theory about Muni's 'ghost buses' to anyone who'd listen. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Barça games are peak excitement, but the real vibe is catching a local jam in a hidden plaza. That's where the heart is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for 'tapas' in a loud voice at every bar—locals know it's just 'pintxos' in the spots serving them.
